requirements.title: Expo development build installs on a physical iOS device, launches instantly with no loading screens, and plays the full game with no network connection (NFR-2, NFR-3).

tests.title: [P1] benchmark: settings serializeSettings->loadSettings round-trip < 0.1ms median (CI-gated JS payload layer, T1.2)

evidence.note: Airplane mode on (Wi-Fi off): app launched instantly (no loading screen, NFR-3), full play session with no network, no crash. Best score + a settings write survived a full process kill/reload while still offline (2 runs; MMKV on-device store restored the persisted best, NFR-2/FR-4/AC-2). Native runtime = manual validation per project rules; evidence recorded in game-architecture.md#Data Persistence, not CI.

requirements.title: Best score and player settings persist across launches via app storage (AsyncStorage/MMKV decision from the spike benchmark T4.5).

requirements.title: Per-match budgets (free undo/continue/hint counts) live in memory only and die with the match (ADR-02).

tests.title: [P0] STORAGE_KEYS never contains budget keys (AC-4: budgets are memory-only)

requirements.title: All assets (13 tile tiers, board, icon, 3 SFX) are bundled and preloaded, self-contained offline — no CDN (NFR-6).

tests.title: [P2] AC-5/NFR-6: assetManifest is a non-empty object/array of bundled asset entries
[P2] AC-5/NFR-6: assetManifest references only local bundled assets (no remote URL strings)
[P2] AC-5/NFR-6: assetManifest does not reference a CDN host

evidence.note: Manifest is data-driven and additive (icon + present bundled assets); 13 tile-tier hexes + board + 3 SFX are generated later (Epic 8/9 — build-order dependency documented in readiness report line 231). Preload before render is wired in App.tsx (ready gate, T5.3) — native/on-device preload is manual validation. Current automated scope (manifest constraints) is fully covered.
